name: Kohaku
source:
"You said you really were a teacher! Why are you so angry?"

A young angel who came to Rukiel's house. Because he is still uneducated, he is
naughty and disobedient. What kind of angel he grows into is up to Rukiel.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110407061816fw_/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/anjel_s.html]official website[/url]]

He grows older throughout the story.
